description: Source code implementing VDSO support functions for kernel symbol lookup, including initialization, symbol lookup, and CPU identification, with platform-specific handling.

classes.name: VDSOSupport
classes.description: Class providing support for kernel VDSO, including initialization, symbol lookup, and CPU identification.

methods.name: VDSOSupport
methods.description: Constructor initializing VDSO support, possibly calling Init.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes VDSO base address by reading auxiliary vectors or /proc/self/auxv.

methods.name: SetBase
methods.description: Sets the VDSO base address manually.

methods.name: LookupSymbol
methods.description: Looks up a symbol in the VDSO image.

methods.name: LookupSymbolByAddress
methods.description: Looks up symbol information by address.

methods.name: GetCPUViaSyscall
methods.description: Performs a syscall to get CPU ID, fallback if not available.

methods.name: InitAndGetCPU
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves CPU ID using VDSO or syscall.

methods.name: GetCPU
methods.description: Fast function to get current CPU ID, callable from low-level code.
